newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia dismisses Supreme Court head - tv.
newsitem.headline: Croatia dismisses Supreme Court head - tv.

text.p: Croatia's top judicial body decided on Tuesday to remove the head of the country's Supreme Court, alleging he had sexual relations with minors, the state television station HRT reported.
The National Judicial Council said in a statement that Judge Krunoslav Olujic had tainted the Supreme Court's reputation by "maintaining sexual relationships with under-aged persons", HRT said.

It said the council was taking disciplinary action against the judge and that he had been suspended until disciplinary proceedings were completed. The government had instructed the council to act against Olujic after it proposed his dismissal.
